question: In 2019, a minor planet between Mars and Jupiter was named after, whom among the following Indian musicians by the International Astronomical Union (IAU)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pt Jasraj.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **minor planet **was named **"Panditjasraj"** after the Indian classical vocalist **Pandit Jasraj **by the** IAU.**
 
• Pandit Jasraj was a renowned Indian classical vocalist belonging to the **Mewati Gharana.**
 
• He was born in** Haryana in 1930** and passed away in **August 2020.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Indian music director **Hariprasad Chaurasia** is a classical flautist and **bansuri player** in the Hindustani classical style.

 
 
• In **1984,** he was awarded **Sangeet Natak Academy.**
 
 
 
• **Pt Ravi Shankar** was an **Indian composer** and **sitarist.**
 
 
• He was well known for his attempts to bring Indian music to the West and for having influenced popular music in the** United States and Great Britain.** 
 
 
 
• Indian** tabla player**, composer, percussionist, music producer, and actor in motion pictures is **Ustad Zakir Hussain.** ** **
 
 
• **Padma Shri** (1988), **Padma Bhushan **(2002), and **Padma Vibhushan** (2023) were given to him.
